'''Corehuin''' is an [[Aiel]] woman of the [[Jahad Hold]] of the [[Broken Cliff]] sept of the [[Daryne]] clan.

==History==
She is the wife of [[Mandelain]] and [[sister-wife]] of [[Jair]]. 

She is not the [[Roofmistress]] of the Hold and so was able to accompany Mandelain when he left the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Corehuin}}{{ref/book|7|18}}
